LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V2_B_STANCE_0_1.zh_CN: ，认为年龄不该决定谁必须听谁的。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V2_B_STANCE_0_1.en: , refusing to let age decide who must obey whom.

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V2_B_STANCE_1_1.source: ，训人的资格也得接受同样的检验。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V2_B_STANCE_1_1.zh_CN: ，认为定规矩的人也得接受质疑。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V2_B_STANCE_1_1.en: , holding rule-makers open to the same questions.

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V2_B_STANCE_2_1.source: ，双方各过各的生活，也各担自己的选择。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V2_B_STANCE_2_1.en: , allowing both sides to make their own choices.

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V2_B_STANCE_0_2.source: ，旧资历被顶开，也露出了新的圈内高低。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V2_B_STANCE_0_2.zh_CN: ，也觉得自己的见识比对方更可靠。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V2_B_STANCE_0_2.en: , claiming better judgement than the lecturer.

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V2_B_STANCE_1_2.source: ，较量落在谁能占住教训人的位置。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V2_B_STANCE_1_2.en: , seeking the right to lecture in return.

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V2_B_STANCE_2_2.source: ，夺回自主也带着不愿再居人下的意思。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V2_B_STANCE_2_2.en: , refusing to be treated as inferior.
